Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes Restore native text deselection when users click blank space beside chat messages while keeping avatars and message footers nonselectable. **Example:** Select “Checking the guard implementation before editing.” and click the blank transcript margin. - **Before:** The text remains highlighted. - **After:** The selection clears. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | A focused repair with inspected before/after proof, meaningful existing browser coverage, and no outstanding review finding. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected screenshots show the production Control UI in Chromium with synthetic conversation data clearing the previously stuck selection after a blank-space click; the current-head consolidation preserves that CSS behavior, and Safari remains explicitly unverified. | | **Patch quality** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Selected chat text stays highlighted after clicking blank transcript space. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction fixes a demonstrated interaction regression with a focused change and preserves the earlier text-selection contract. ## Regression provenance Regression provenance — suspected predecessor, not a causality claim: source commit `debc7123f743` by Vyctor H. Brzezowski; no PR verified. Possible regression — suspected (reviewed change). No predecessor PR is attributed. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** This PR fixes a current Control UI bug with a small CSS change. The earlier consolidation finding is resolved, and no new actionable defect was found; exact-head CI remains pending. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `241a53fad0bbfcee1efd35faaf9003019c684172` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Control UI renders conversation text and message chrome inside the transcript; its CSS controls how native browser selection responds to dragging, Select All, and blank-space clicks. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Conversation messages] --> B[Chat transcript] C[Selection CSS] --> B B --> D[Native browser selection] E[Blank margin click] --> D D --> F[Cleared selection] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the shared native-selection rule and narrow chrome exclusions, then land this focused fix once its existing CI gates pass. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main CSS exposes the reported native-selection failure, and the supplied Chromium before/after evidence supports the reproduction; no target code was executed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The patch repairs the CSS owner directly, preserves targeted chrome exclusions, and extends existing browser coverage without adding selection-clearing JavaScript or new state. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [8a35cf6b3311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8a35cf6b3311196d4e44811e07e00deff05a6d15). ### Provenance checked - `Transcript selection policy` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (49e32cbda0c277b83bf3a77d2d618f7427ccec1c: Exclude transcript chrome and media from selection while retaining selectable message and reasoning text.) - `Blank-space browser assertion` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (4d8806c8c2e297af9bc06f5cc73d4b0a3a8f949b: Preserve existing blank-space behavior while constraining double-click drags to their source message.) - `Form-controls browser expectation` keeps the original intent (2e72edbdc2f0a8e4b0a9e8090c0f636da5e664c5: Consolidate browser coverage while retaining existing contracts; the changed expectation follows the repaired transcript selection policy.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Reviewed PR introduction:** The introduced diff changes selection CSS and existing browser coverage without adding handlers, state, configuration, or dependencies. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/startup-layout.css:195`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/241a53fad0bbfcee1efd35faaf9003019c684172/ui/src/styles/chat/startup-layout.css#L195), [241a53fad0bb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/241a53fad0bbfcee1efd35faaf9003019c684172)) - **Current main still contains the cause:** Fetched main still applies user-select: none to the transcript root, preventing native blank-space deselection. Replaced prior `rating: 🦪 silver shellfish`. - add `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - remove `rating: 🦪 silver shellfish`: Current PR rating is `rating: 🦞 diamond lobster`, so this older rating label is no longer current. - remove `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: Current PR status label is `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`.
